text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Trainer.
I can't believe you actually got it for me...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay for me to have this?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'll be sure to tell them
that you're the one who got it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I wonder if those girls will like it... Fufu.
